description: This file declares template functions for quantization and dequantization of floating-point values to integer types, including specialized functions for ARM architectures and requantization utilities. It is part of the ATen/native namespace, indicating low-level core tensor operations related to quantization in PyTorch.

methods.name: quantize_val
methods.description: Templates for quantizing a float value into an integer type T using scale and zero_point.

methods.name: quantize_val_arm
methods.description: ARM-specific template function for quantizing a float value.

methods.name: quantize_vec
methods.description: Template for quantizing a vector of floats into type T.

methods.name: dequantize_val
methods.description: Templates for converting a quantized integer value back into float using scale and zero_point.

methods.name: dequantize_vec
methods.description: Template for dequantizing a vector of quantized values into floats.

methods.name: requantize_val
methods.description: Template for requantizing a value from one quantization scale/zero_point to another.

methods.name: requantize_from_int
methods.description: Requantizes an integer value based on a multiplier and zero_point.

methods.name: quantize_val_float_qparams
methods.description: Quantizes a float value given explicit quantization parameters and qmin/qmax bounds.
